video_title: The Smart Home Doll House Dashboard
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies Tapo as the sponsor of Paul Hibbert's August 15, 2026 English-language YouTube video with the explicit disclosure 'This video is sponsored by Tapo. All opinions are my own.' SponsorRadar tracks 46 Tapo deals across 21 creators and shows most recent spend concentrated on 50K-250K channels, with sponsored creators as small as Wanderer001 Reviews (~36K) and Nater Tater (~76K). Tapo sells tangible smart-home cameras, robot vacuums, plugs, lighting and related hardware. Tapo's official US Affiliate Program explicitly accepts social media influencers, publishers and content creators and publishes affiliates.shopus@tp-link.com to confirm affiliate eligibility.
